svg.title: Draw it: one kernel, one window, one cell
svg.desc: A large empty dashed frame for the student to draw in, with three instructions underneath: draw a picture with a window outlined on it and the same window one step to the right; draw the kernel once with an arrow to every position it visits; and write out the nine products for one window and the single number they add up to.
svg.text: Draw it: one kernel, one window, one cell
1. a picture with a window outlined on it, and the same window one step right
2. the kernel drawn once, with an arrow to every position it visits
3. the nine products for one window, and the one number they add up to
